collection.name: Inflatables: Arrival by Shaderism x Vivid Gallery
collection.description:
Inflatables is the first fully animated generative art and interactive profile-picture collection powered by Bitcoin data. 

The artist behind the collection, Shaderism, renowned generative artist behind the Art Blocks Curated collection Blind Spots and the Vivid Gallery Curated collection Looming Emotion. 

In collaboration with Vivid Gallery and inspired by Jeff Koons’s iconic balloon animal sculptures, Inflatables fuses playful artistry with cutting-edge blockchain innovation.
